newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Jan-Apr BOP surplus falls to $450 mln.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Jan-Apr BOP surplus falls to $450 mln.

text.p: The Philippines posted a balance of payments surplus of $450 million in the first four months of the year compared with $1.43 billion a year earlier, the Central Bank said on Wednesday.
Central Bank research director Diwa Gunigundo said the lower surplus was brought on lower dollar inflows by the Central Bank during the period and payments of loans.
In the past month, the Central Bank had to defend the peso against speculative attacks from the problems in the Thai baht by selling dollars, Gunigundo added.
